en: Hover a line for details. C - close
Raw power and toughness. More health and stamina, harder hits that push enemies farther, less damage taken, more carry weight, and poison wears off sooner.
Speed and reflexes. You attack and move faster, enemies miss you more often and your dodge protects you longer.
Mind. More mana for abilities, and a bit more damage.
Sharp eyes. More critical hits, a wider light around you, more of the map revealed, and you spot monsters and traps from farther away.
Fortune. It does nothing yet; its effects come later.
